title: vtc-wss: minor consistency fixes
description: Blocked rule cites 'role-change' notifications (:313) but VTCParticipantEvent.event is joined/left/kicked (vtc-00:1464). Security list (:553) only names VTCRingEvent for delivery-time block checks though :303 covers in-call events. Does not require co-advertising jmap:websocket and jmap:vtc (scene-wss :136 does).
close_reason: role-change -> kick; security list covers all blocked events. Co-advertise MUST deliberately not added (implementations do it anyway).
